en.name: Searching Fuden
en.effect: Add 1 "Dimension Pair Link L", "Dimension Pair Link R", or "Fuden Issen" from your Graveyard to your hand. Then, you can shuffle 3 monsters from your Graveyard into the Deck. Then, if you shuffled an EARTH Attribute monster by this effect, you can make 1 face-up monster on your opponent's field lose 600 ATK until the end of this turn.
